automated.summary: All seven required leaves execute and pass, each verified by its junit testcase NAME and its EXECUTED count rather than an exit code (D-0024, D-0031): every report shows tests 1 / pass 1 / fail 0 / skipped 0. python3 factory/scripts/verify.py passes across structural, typecheck, quality and test, and the full hermetic suite is green (backend node:test, 14 frontend files / 56 tests, the contract suite and the quality gate itself). The app-DB migration proof is DEMONSTRATED HOST EVIDENCE under D-0008: it cannot reach 127.0.0.1:5432 from the sandbox (EPERM, signal S-0008-b46e), so the orchestrator ran it from the host against the app-db container, where it creates a scratch database, applies 0000_auth_audit.sql, asserts the base table set, applies 0001_saved_and_pins.sql and asserts the set is exactly the base plus dashboard_pins and saved_queries - then drops the scratch database WITH (FORCE) in a finally block. A dead-port PGPORT=5599 control fails that same leaf on ECONNREFUSED (tests 1 / pass 0 / fail 1), so the green run is real database work and not a silent skip.

non_blocking_findings: The app-DB migration proof is host evidence, not CI-enforced, under D-0008: CI has no Postgres service container, so backend/package.json test:db is not run there. This is the same model every prior DB-backed proof in this project uses.

D-0024 and D-0031 remain open, so every leaf here was verified by its junit testcase name and executed count rather than by an exit code; a required_test whose leaf name drifted would still report green having asserted nothing.
